title: 固定快捷键导致误操作，如意外砸地板
description: 固定快捷键导致误操作，如意外砸地板
evidence: Awkward quick-button assignments (like fixed hotkeys causing you to accidentally bash floors) combined with frame stuttering lead to constant, maddening misclicks.

evidence_items.quote: Awkward quick-button assignments (like fixed hotkeys causing you to accidentally bash floors) combined with frame stuttering lead to constant, maddening misclicks.
evidence_items.description: 固定快捷键导致误操作，如意外砸地板
evidence_items.quote_zh: 别扭的快捷按钮分配（比如固定的热键导致你意外砸地板）加上画面卡顿，导致不断出现令人抓狂的误点。
